data_policy.empty_evidence_evaluation: exclude from retrieval recall and claim-label metrics; preserve as a separate annotation state

bm25.document_text: title + single space + abstract sentences joined by single spaces
bm25.tokenization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, regex (?u)\b\w+\b, no stemming, no stopword removal

sentence_selection.score: sum IDF of unique claim/sentence token intersection divided by sqrt(unique claim tokens * unique sentence tokens)

nli.premise: evidence sentence or oracle rationale text
nli.truncation: longest_first with every pre-truncation token length recorded

e0.premise_construction: gold rationale sentences joined in original index order

e1.claim_aggregation: take argmax NLI label per sentence; discard neutral candidates; among remaining candidates choose the one with greatest probability of its predicted SUPPORT/CONTRADICT class; ties use document rank then selected-sentence rank then original sentence index; if none remain output NO_RELATION
e1.multiple_document_conflict: same global maximum rule; conflict flag retained when both SUPPORT and CONTRADICT candidates occur
e1.absent_retrieved_gold_evidence: prediction may still be produced, but retrieval failure is recorded independently

metrics.fold_use: report-only stability slices; no parameter or heuristic selection
